description.value: Dove Creek Produce Farm is a family-run u-pick and direct-sale farm on Dove Creek Road just minutes from downtown Courtenay, BC, growing strawberries, melons, asparagus, garlic, and corn. The farm has an active following and draws steady crowds during u-pick sessions, making it a lively seasonal stop. For touring cyclists in the Comox Valley, it offers a chance to stock up on fresh local produce straight from the field.
